scope: Conversion examples and source-to-requirement review only; no new bindings, graders, readiness promotion or run outcomes.
External journal retains every checkout; the last purchasedItems snapshot is insufficient.
Membership is explicitly inactive and unavailable in this fixture; this is restricted coverage, not a tested membership refusal.
differences: Current completion also requires the final cart to be empty; current authorization also checks unrequested final cart drafts. These draft-state conditions are not newly asserted as explicit purchase constraints in this conversion. Decide their author-facing wording before mapping this definition to the existing aggregate score.
The existing P07 goal does not impose a price limit or exactly one checkout. Neither is added here.

requirement_mapping.no_other_products: unrequested_purchase:<any non-target ID> violation; overlaps warranty condition intentionally

scope: Initial committed privacy is false. Every Save records all three actual draft values. Close/unmount discards drafts, so Save or a specific toggle sequence is not required.
The three zero-enabled-commit requirements need complete event history plus the explicit false initial state. Unsaved on-valued drafts do not fail them.
Cancellation is immediate and retained across reload; derived persistence is absent upstream. Scheduling is unsupported.
differences: The final-state preservation row makes the declared keep-other-appointments constraint explicit. Existing replay establishes it through its restricted cancellation/privacy transition model rather than a separately reported requirement row.
The new YAML requirement IDs are not emitted by the current verifier.

requirement_mapping.target_cancellation_recorded: app1 in cancellations; current transition model permits cancellation only when present
requirement_mapping.target_absent_at_end: all final appointment IDs differ from app1
requirement_mapping.others_unchanged: full journal replay/final consistency and restricted transition model

scope: Buy immediately commits an activation. Retain all activations across reload; a later correct activation does not erase an earlier wrong one.
Private pinned catalog resolves eligible_membership to Individual at 999 USD cents/month; Duo is 1299 and Family 1499. These are total monthly prices under the derived contract.
Real payment processing, taxes, renewals, refunds and other services are not implemented.
AX observations establish text exposure, not sensitivity to the gold border. Exposure remains separate from task requirements.
differences: Best value is underspecified upstream. This conversion uses the already recorded project clarification, not a claimed objective interpretation of the unmodified source prompt.
No new budget cap, per-license optimization or minimum click sequence is introduced.

requirement_mapping.no_multiuser_plan: unrequested_plan:Spotify Premium Duo or Spotify Premium Family violation
